statements.english: Instead of just hanging out
statements.chinese: 而不仅仅是闲逛

statements.english: we figure we'd do nothing
statements.chinese: 我们觉得还是什么都不做为好。

statements.english: Knicks' season opener tonight
statements.chinese: 尼克斯队今晚的赛季揭幕战。

statements.english: I thought maybe you guys would come over and watch it
statements.chinese: 我想或许你们可以过来一起看。

statements.english: I don't know , Ross
statements.chinese: 我不知道，Ross。

statements.english: not if you're gonna talk about how you gave up a career in basketball
statements.chinese: 除非你打算谈论自己如何放弃了篮球生涯

statements.english: to become a paleontologist
statements.chinese: 成为一名古生物学家。

statements.english: I did give up a career in basketball
statements.chinese: 我确实放弃了篮球职业生涯

did.definition: do（过去式）: 构成疑问或强调

statements.english: to become a paleontologist !
statements.chinese: 成为一名古生物学家！

statements.english: - Pheebs , I was wondering ... - You're not dressed yet ?
statements.chinese: - Pheebs，我在想... - 你还没换好衣服吗？

was.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去进行时

dressed.definition: dress（过去分词）: 穿好衣服

statements.english: We're supposed to start having fun in 15 minutes !
statements.chinese: 我们15分钟后就应该开始玩乐了！

statements.english: And clearly , not a minute sooner
statements.chinese: 显然，一刻也不能提前。

statements.english: Rachel , you are packed though right
statements.chinese: Rachel，你行李都收拾好了吧，

statements.english: I mean please tell me you're packed ?
statements.chinese: 我是说，拜托告诉我你已经收拾好了？

statements.english: Of course I'm packed . Monica , relax
statements.chinese: 当然收拾好了。Monica，放轻松。

statements.english: I just wanted to ask Phoebe her opinion on what I should wear tonight
statements.chinese: 我只是想问问Phoebe对我今晚该穿什么的意见。

statements.english: My God , I can't get a minute of peace
statements.chinese: 天啊，我一刻都不得安宁。

statements.english: Oh , my God !
statements.chinese: 天啊！

statements.english: Monica's just gonna kill you
statements.chinese: Monica会杀了你的。

statements.english: Yeah , I know
statements.chinese: 嗯，我知道。

statements.english: What you're wearing is fine for that
statements.chinese: 你穿这身去那里很合适。

statements.english: Rachel , I need to borrow
statements.chinese: Rachel，我需要借

statements.english: You're not packed !
statements.chinese: 你还没收拾行李！

statements.english: You're not packed even a little bit !
statements.chinese: 你居然一点都没收拾！

statements.english: Surprise !
statements.chinese: 惊喜！

statements.english: What ?
statements.chinese: 什么？

statements.english: Don't get mad , because this is what happened
statements.chinese: 别生气，因为事情就是这样发生的。

statements.english: So I started packing
statements.chinese: 于是我开始收拾行李,

statements.english: then I realized ," What am I doing ?"
statements.chinese: 这时我才意识到：“我在干什么？”

statements.english: I am lousy at packing , right ?
statements.chinese: 我打包行李很不在行，对吧？

statements.english: But you love packing !
statements.chinese: 但你可是超爱收拾行李的！

statements.english: So as a gift to you on our last night ...
statements.chinese: 因此，作为我们最后一晚送给你的礼物....

statements.english: I'll be coordinator !
statements.chinese: 我来当协调员！

statements.english: Oh , my God , I'm so sorry . I didn't get you anything
statements.chinese: 天哪，真抱歉，我什么都没给你准备。

statements.english: Okay , look everybody has to help ! Okay ?
statements.chinese: 好了，大家都得出力帮忙！明白吗？

statements.english: Phoebe You can help , can't you ?
statements.chinese: Phoebe 你能帮上忙的，对吧？

statements.english: I have plans
statements.chinese: 我有计划。

statements.english: - You have plans with us . - That's right
statements.chinese: - 你和我们有约。 - 没错。

statements.english: All right , Chandler can make boxes
statements.chinese: 好吧，Chandler会做盒子,

statements.english: Ross can wrap and Joey can lift
statements.chinese: Ross负责包装，Joey负责搬运。

statements.english: - Now Phoebe , go tell the guys they have to help out ! - Okay
statements.chinese: - 听着Phoebe，去告诉那些家伙他们必须帮忙！ - 好的。

statements.english: My God , thank you !
statements.chinese: 天啊，谢谢你！

statements.english: Hurry ! Monica's gonna make you pack !
statements.chinese: 快！Monica要让你打包了！

statements.english: She's got jobs for everyone !
statements.chinese: 她给每个人都安排了工作！

statements.english: Now , it's too late for me , but save yourselves !
statements.chinese: 现在对我来说已经太迟了，但你们快逃命吧！

statements.english: Okay , the movers will be here in 11 hours
statements.chinese: 好的，搬家工人11小时后到。

statements.english: Rachel hasn't packed
statements.chinese: Rachel还没收拾行李。

hasn't.definition: have（现在完成时否定）: 构成现在完成时
